# Task

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Task`](gmeow-Task.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Task>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A to-do or task — an event with a due date, status, priority, and optional recurrence-until-done. A subtype of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) so it participates in the full event spine: temporal placement, location, participation, and scheduling. The kind of task is a [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) value, never a subclass ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Task`](gmeow-Task.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an iCalendar VTODO — a to-do with a due date, status, and priority that should inherit the full event spine (temporal placement, location, participation, scheduling).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a fixed-time meeting (a plain [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)) and avoid subclassing it for the kind of task; the kind is a [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) value ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Type it [`gmeow:Task`](gmeow-Task.md) (inheriting [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)), set [`gmeow:taskDueDate`](../properties/gmeow-taskDueDate.md), [`gmeow:taskStatus`](../properties/gmeow-taskStatus.md), and [`gmeow:taskPriority`](../properties/gmeow-taskPriority.md); use [`gmeow:taskRecurrenceUntilDone`](../properties/gmeow-taskRecurrenceUntilDone.md) for an open-ended recurring task and [`gmeow:eventType`](../properties/gmeow-eventType.md) for its kind.

### Examples

- ex:fileReport a [`gmeow:Task`](gmeow-Task.md); [`gmeow:taskDueDate`](../properties/gmeow-taskDueDate.md) "2026-06-20T17:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); [`gmeow:taskStatus`](../properties/gmeow-taskStatus.md) [`gmeow:taskStatusInProgress`](../individuals/gmeow-taskStatusInProgress.md); [`gmeow:taskPriority`](../properties/gmeow-taskPriority.md) 1.
